jangsaeng.name: Birth of New Life
jangsaeng.meaning: A period of birth and protection.

mokyok.name: Pure Beginning
mokyok.meaning: A time when the old is washed away, and life begins to bloom delicately.

gwandai.name: Gateway to Adulthood
gwandai.meaning: The period of formally entering the world of responsibility.

geunrok.name: Arrival of the Golden Age
geunrok.meaning: A time when professional and social achievements reach their peak.

jewang.name: Imperial Realm
jewang.meaning: A period when absolute authority and energy reach their zenith.

soe.name: Tranquil Wisdom
soe.meaning: A period of graceful transition from action to reflection.

byeong.name: Inner Reflection
byeong.meaning: A time when the soul deepens through physical stillness.

sa.name: Spiritual Transition
sa.meaning: The end of one cycle and the precursor to rebirth.

myo.name: Cosmic Reservoir
myo.meaning: A period of gathering and preserving the essence of life.

jeol.name: Great Void
jeol.meaning: A point of absolute stillness before a new spark ignites.

tae.name: Conception of Destiny
tae.meaning: A time when the soul's energy gathers invisibly.

yang.name: Growth of Patience
yang.meaning: A period of being nurtured in the darkness before emerging into the light.
